title: USER_LOGIN_ACTIVITY_V1
description: JSON schema for Observe.ai bulk S3 export of user login activity records. Each file is gzip-compressed JSON (USER_LOGIN_ACTIVITY_V1_<timestamp>.json.gz). Each record is one JSON object.

_id.description: Unique identifier for this record (source system primary key).

appid.description: Application identifier associated with the login session.

expiry.description: UTC timestamp when the login session expires.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when the record was created.

modified_at.description: UTC timestamp when the record was last modified.

login_type.description: Method used to log in (e.g. PASSWORD, SSO).

power_user.description: Whether the user is flagged as a power user.

logout_time.description: UTC timestamp when the user logged out.
